topology_reasoning: 1x4 multimode interferometer (MMI): single input waveguide feeds into a wide rectangular core that supports 4 guided modes. The 4 output ports are arranged vertically at the top, each with a taper transitioning from the MMI core to single-mode width.
function_knobs: mmi_width: multimode core width (set to 24 μm, full footprint)
mmi_height: MMI core height (tuned to 7 μm)
taper_length: taper transition length (tuned to 1 μm)
taper_width_mmi: taper base width at MMI (tuned to 2.2 μm)
port_spacing: output port center spacing (tuned to 5.8 μm)

iterations.change: Scaled MMI to footprint width; height still too large
Simplified geometry, removed separate input taper — failed
Reintroduced proper tapers with wider base
Refined taper widths and port spacing
Compact ports and shorter tapers — best IoU reached

final_assessment: Achieved IoU 0.4388 after 6 iterations. Topology is correct (1x4 MMI), but pixel-level fidelity is limited by reverse-engineering the exact taper profile from a B&W image. The device is parametric and functional; knobs move geometry as intended. Further improvement would require higher-fidelity source image or access to the original design parameters.
